alltäglicher Ethereum-Token, Anonym. Es ist ein mächtiger

invalid_evm_address: The destination is not a valid EVM address.

ootle_no_peg_out: wTARI is redeemable for Ootle TARI only.
ootle_too_many_open_wraps: You already have too many pending wraps. Finish or wait for your pending wraps before starting a new one.
ootle_unavailable: Ootle bridging is unavailable: Tari Universe does not support Ootle on this network, or your wallet PIN is not set.
switch_chain_error: Switch your wallet to {{chain}} to continue.
ootle_wrap_error: We could not start your wrap. Your TARI has not been sent; please try again.
ootle_wrap_unconfirmed: Your TARI deposit was sent but we could not confirm it yet. Reopen the bridge to retry, and keep the transaction ID below.
ootle_wrap_in_flight: Your Ootle deposit is still being confirmed. You can start another bridge once it completes.
ootle_wrap_unfinished: An earlier TARI deposit is not confirmed yet. We are retrying it now; please wait for it to finish before starting another bridge.
ootle_wrap_check_failed: We could not check for an earlier unconfirmed TARI deposit, so no new bridge was started. Please try again.
ootle_wrap_fee_only: Your TARI deposit was not accepted: only the network fee was deducted, the amount stayed in your Ootle wallet.
wrap_unconfirmed: We could not confirm that your deposit was sent. Check your transaction history before trying again.
ootle_wrap_maybe_sent: We could not tell whether your TARI deposit was sent. Check your Ootle wallet history before dismissing this or trying again.
